own: The Central Superbase, its rooms, story and characters are the team's own design.

nasaUse.how: Every build downloads the strongest solar flare of the last 12 months from NASA DONKI, through NASA Open APIs. Night 4 starts with that real flare on the Control screen (the story year is 2071, the real date is shown below it) and it triggers the solar storm: no signal, machines down, red lights.
RadLab radiation doses on the ISS are why the Equipment Shielding upgrade exists and why fewer rooms fail in the storm when you have it.

ECLSS shaped the water and oxygen rooms: melting ice costs energy, the electrolyzer splits water into oxygen, CO2 filters fill up. OSDR lettuce studies and the CSA Veggie kit shaped the greenhouse and its harvest task.
Mars Trek terrain guided where the base, the buried ice and the solar field are placed.
YANA's facts, the questions before sleep and the upgrade notes come from these sources, written for ages 7 to 14 with the help of the CSA STEM resources.
